articles.title: Binance joins STOP THE TRAFFIK in anti-human trafficking effort
articles.snippet: The partnership expands Binance’s compliance efforts by providing intelligence and training to help detect cryptocurrency activity tied to human trafficking and child exploitation.

articles.title: Pavel Durov Wants to Give a Billion Telegram Users a Crypto Wallet
articles.snippet: The promise of instant, zero-fee crypto transactions for over a billion Telegram users sent its native Gram token up 7%.
